; example.com as an RFC 1035 zone file (BIND), written by DomainScope from bind.

## octodns (example.com.yaml, application/yaml;charset=utf-8, 30 written)
# example.com as an octoDNS zone (example.com.yaml), written by DomainScope from bind.
# Keys are in octoDNS order; the SOA, the apex NS and what octoDNS cannot hold are left out (see the notes).
---
'':
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        proxied: true
    ttl: 300
    type: ALIAS
    value: apex-target.example.net.
  - ttl: 3600
    type: CAA
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: letsencrypt.org
      - flags: 128
        tag: issuewild
        value: ';'
      - flags: 1
        tag: iodef
        value: 'mailto:security@example.com'
      - flags: 0
        tag: policy
        value: strict
  - ttl: 3600
    type: NAPTR
    value:
      flags: S
      order: 100
      preference: 10
      regexp: ''
      replacement: _sip._udp.example.com.
      service: 'SIP+D2U'
'*.apps':
  ttl: 3600
  type: A
  value: '203.0.113.20'
_443._tcp.www:
  ttl: 3600
  type: TLSA
  value:
    certificate_association_data: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
    certificate_usage: 3
    matching_type: 1

## dnscontrol (dnsconfig.js, text/javascript;charset=utf-8, 30 written)
// example.com as DNSControl's dnsconfig.js, written by DomainScope from bind.
// Read the notes DomainScope listed, then run `dnscontrol preview` before `dnscontrol push`.
var REG_NONE = NewRegistrar("none");
var DSP_MAIN = NewDnsProvider("main"); // the name of your provider's entry in creds.json

D("example.com", REG_NONE, DnsProvider(DSP_MAIN),
    DefaultTTL(3600),
    ALIAS("@", "apex-target.example.net.", TTL(300), CF_PROXY_ON),
    CAA("@", "issue", "letsencrypt.org"),
    CAA("@", "issuewild", ";", CAA_CRITICAL),
    CAA("@", "iodef", "mailto:security@example.com"),
    CAA("@", "policy", "strict"),
    NAPTR("@", 100, 10, "S", "SIP+D2U", "", "_sip._udp.example.com."),
    A("www", "192.0.2.10", TTL(300), CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("mixed", "192.0.2.30", TTL(300), CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("mixed", "192.0.2.31", TTL(300)),
    CNAME("status", "status.example.org.", TTL(300)),
    A("ns1", "192.0.2.53"),
    A("mail", "192.0.2.25"),
    AAAA("mail", "2001:db8::25"),
    MX("null", 0, "."),
    A("ttls", "198.51.100.1", TTL(300)),
    A("ttls", "198.51.100.2", TTL(300)),
    A("dup", "198.51.100.9"),
    A("*.apps", "203.0.113.20"),
    A("a.*.inner", "203.0.113.21"),
    TXT("a\\032b", "a name with a space"),
    TXT("google._domainkey", ["v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0mat", "erialx0example0key0materialx0example0key0mate"]),
    TXT("split", ["v=spf1 ", "include:_spf.example.net ", "-all"]),
    TXT("quoted", "say \"hi\"; a back\\slash"),
    SRV("_sip._tcp", 10, 60, 5060, "sip.example.com."),
    TLSA("_443._tcp.www", 3, 1, 1, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
    HTTPS("svc", 1, ".", "alpn=\"h2,h3\" ipv4hint=192.0.2.10"),
    SVCB("_svc", 1, "svc.example.net.", "port=8443"),
    SSHFP("host", 4, 2, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
    NS("sub", "ns1.example.net."),
    DS("sub", 12345, 13, 2, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
    // not written (not a record type this format holds): old DNAME new.example.net.
    // not written (not a record type this format holds): spf SPF "v=spf1 -all"
    // not written (not a record type this format holds): uri URI 10 1 "https://www.example.com/"
    // not written (not a record type this format holds): geo LOC 52 22 23.000 N 4 53 32.000 E -2.00m 0.00m 10000m 10m
    // not written (not a record type this format holds): alias ALIAS target.example.net.
END);
